About Chainlink

Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that delivers off-chain data such as price feeds to smart contracts, plus cross-chain messaging (CCIP). LINK pays node operators and is used for staking.

Where this LINK price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (LINK-USD), Binance (LINK/USDT) and Kraken (LINK/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 678,100,000 LINK (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
